reason: On Linux x86_64 with installed uv 0.12.3, running `uv version --bump foo` in an empty temporary directory exits 2, writes nothing to stdout, and emits exactly 35 stderr bytes: `error: invalid bump component `foo`` with no ANSI styling or trailing newline. A pseudo-terminal control using `uv version --bump` was styled and newline-terminated. Python 3.12.3 versus the reported 3.14.6 is immaterial because failure occurs during CLI parsing. The issue-context README was updated.
